description: Starts a paid, prepaid analysis package from text inputs; the whole quoted price is charged in credits immediately. Call it only after the user approved the quoted price from qualitative_quote_analysis (show price, model and effort first). Requires sign-in (OAuth connector or API key) with the runs:write scope. Pass `quoted_price_credits`, `expected_model` and `expected_effort` from that quote: if the price or the model changed, the call fails with quote_stale or model_changed and nothing is charged; show the new values to the user and ask again. Inputs are JSON text only (`inputs.transcript`: 1-10 items {name, text}; every other slot: one item), at most about 1 MB of text per call; larger inputs need the REST API with a multipart upload. It returns at once with a `run_id`; the analysis runs in the background, so follow it with qualitative_get_run. Do not call this tool again to check progress. Without an `idempotency_key` the key is derived from the exact input, so an identical call within 24 hours returns the same analysis (`replayed`: true) and is not charged again (after 24 hours it starts and charges a new one); to deliberately start a second identical analysis, pass a new `idempotency_key`. Without enough credits it answers payment_required and charges nothing; credits are managed in the user's SurveysAI account on the website.

analysis_brief.description: The research objective (required, up to 5000 characters) and optional context.

expected_effort.description: The `effort` of the approved quote (null when the quote has none).

idempotency_key.description: Optional key (printable ASCII, at most 255 characters). Omit it normally: the key is derived from the exact input, so an identical call within 24 hours returns the same analysis (`replayed`: true) and is not charged again. To deliberately start a second identical analysis, pass a new idempotency_key.

inputs.description: Input texts by slot: transcript 1-10 items {name, text}, every other slot one item. At most about 1 MB of text in total; larger inputs need the REST API.
